definition.description: Splits large text documents into smaller chunks for embedding and RAG workflows. Respects paragraph boundaries to avoid cutting mid-sentence. Each chunk includes auto-generated metadata (index, character count, word count) that can be merged with custom metadata for use with Vector Store nodes.

inputFields.placeholderText: Paste or use placeholder for large text...
inputFields.helpText: The full text content to split into chunks. Can be from a file, API response, or any text source. Paragraphs are detected by double newlines (\n\n).
Maximum tokens per chunk. OpenAI ada-002 supports 8191 tokens, but smaller chunks (256-512) often give better retrieval results. Uses ~4 characters per token estimate.
Number of tokens to overlap between chunks (not yet implemented - reserved for future use).
Optional identifier for the source document. Added to each chunk's metadata as 'sourceId'. Useful for filtering during retrieval.
Optional JSON object with custom metadata to merge into each chunk. These fields are added alongside the auto-generated metadata (chunkIndex, charCount, etc.).

outputParameters.description: JSON array of chunks, each with {text, metadata}. Ready for use with Vector Store node in a loop.
Text of the first chunk. Useful for preview or single-chunk use cases.
Metadata JSON for the first chunk.
Total character count of input text.
Total word count of input text.
